create_square_attack: create a Square blackbox optimization attack with num_steps, epsilon, initialize_fn, and bounds
run_square_attack: run the Square attack on a 4D tensor with a loss function and random key
schedule_p_values: schedule the proportion of elements to modify across optimization steps
test_square_call: test the Square class __call__ method with a loss function, RNG key, and input tensor
review_square_class: review the Square class that performs blackbox optimization as described in arXiv:1912.00049
